intro: One bowl of ais kacang (ABC) has an estimated 300 kcal. Most of the calories come from syrup, sugar and sweetened condensed milk.
diet: Yes, once in a while. Ais kacang is almost all sugar, so it won't keep you full for long. No need to avoid it completely. Just don't make it a routine after lunch. Watch the size and toppings, that's the key.
tips: Ask for 'susu sikit' or no condensed milk.
Skip the ice cream and peanut toppings.
Share with a friend after a rice meal.

swap.name: A plate of cut fruit (watermelon/papaya)
swap.why: Still sweet and cold, but with fibre and water. Saves about 200 kcal.

faq.a: ABC is short for 'Air Batu Campur'. It's another name for ais kacang.

faq.q: What's the difference between ais kacang and cendol?
faq.a: Ais kacang uses syrup and condensed milk with lots of toppings. Cendol uses santan and gula melaka.

faq.q: Can I make ais kacang at home?
faq.a: Yes. Use canned red beans, corn, cincau and syrup. You get to control how much sugar goes in.
